what: A six-track groovebox for the M-VAVE FM-1: ten engines and 291 factory presets (analog, six-operator FM, wavetable, drums), a 64-step sequencer with probability, scales and chords, a mod matrix, three FX buses and a browser emulator with its own editor.
author: Guille Lauría
sounds: own: every voice is synthesised by the firmware. The one bank it distributes, gw1-keys.syx, is generated from its own six-operator FM presets: no third-party samples, loops, ROM banks or recordings.
